course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice holding together a short B1-level recap with clear connectors.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A relaxed end-of-week conversation that recaps news, plans, and one small problem.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Summarizing connected everyday information with a clear beginning, middle, and outcome.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik have a Friday fika and recap a small update, a changed plan, and what they will do next.

main_focus.name: coherent recap with connectors
main_focus.description: Use connectors such as först, sedan, därför, and till slut to structure a connected recap.
model_examples: Först ändrades planen, sedan bokade vi ett nytt bord.
Det blev sent, därför tar vi det lugnt ikväll.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use clear connectors naturally 3-4 times to organize the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: new grammar not introduced in Stage 3

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use recap language to integrate earlier Stage 3 patterns without adding new content types.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks for or starts an end-of-week recap.
dialogue_shape.middle: They connect a small update, a changed plan, and a reason using clear connectors.
dialogue_shape.ending: They state the final outcome and a calm next plan.

target_complexity.repetition: review connectors and familiar Stage 3 structures in a natural recap

focus: the main sequence of events in the recap
the final outcome and next plan

sentence_focus: one sentence using först and sedan
one sentence summarizing a changed plan
one sentence combining sequence, reason, and outcome
